rationale: Describes virtualized RAN software that disaggregates RAN functions into software elements connected over open interfaces, for cost-effective, scalable build-out. No AI or learned-model function is described; the data remark is a stated benefit for network optimization, not an AI function.
evidence_spans: vRAN for 5G networks gives mobile network operators (MNOs) a cost-effective solution for network build-out with performance scalability
vRAN disaggregates the functionality of the RAN and connects these software elements using open interfaces
